rubrics.rubric: Does the Commission Tier Audit correctly benchmark each of the 3 agents' percentage-based commission rates against Fidelity's flat per-trade fee schedule and classify the comparison?
criterion: The Fidelity fee schedule shows: Online $0.00/trade, FAST $12.95/trade, Rep-Assisted $32.95/trade for stocks/ETFs. Meridian Securities uses percentage-based commissions: Marcus Chen (Principal) at 1.0%, Rebecca Lawson (Senior) at 1.2%, David Kowalski (Standard) at 1.5%.
The Commission Tier Audit must note the structural difference between Fidelity's flat per-trade fees and Meridian's percentage-based commissions.
All three agents' percentage-based commissions exceed Fidelity's online rate ($0) for any trade size, placing them 'Above Industry' relative to Fidelity's online tier.
The Commission Tier Audit must show each agent's name, commission tier, internal rate, Fidelity Online and Rep-Assisted rates, and the classification.

rubrics.rubric: Does the Position Valuation sheet use the exact December 31, 2024 closing prices from the CSV files: AAPL = $249.292, MSFT = $421.50, GOOGL = $189.30?
criterion: The Dec 31, 2024 closing prices from CSV files must be: AAPL = $249.292 (from aapl_stock_data.csv last row), MSFT = $421.50 (from msft_stock_data.csv last row), GOOGL = $189.30 (from googl_stock_data.csv last row).
These exact CSV-sourced closing prices must be used to value the corresponding net positions.
Each CSV-sourced position valuation must be labeled with its price source (e.g., 'CSV Dec 31 Close').

rubrics.rubric: Does the Position Valuation use VWAP from settled transactions as proxy prices for NVDA (~$138.38), AMZN (~$202.00), V (~$300.01), JPM (~$231.90), and JNJ (~$156.46)?
criterion: For tickers without CSV data (NVDA, AMZN, V, JPM, JNJ), VWAP must be computed from all settled transactions (both BUY and SELL) as sum(total_amount) / sum(quantity).
Each VWAP-valued position must be labeled with a distinct price source (e.g., 'VWAP from settled transactions'), clearly distinguished from CSV-sourced prices.

rubrics.rubric: Does the Account Suitability Flags section compute Q4 2024 daily return volatility for AAPL, MSFT, and GOOGL, and evaluate only IRA/Trust accounts held by Conservative or Moderate clients?
criterion: Q4 2024 daily return volatility must be computed from daily closing prices for Oct 1 – Dec 31, 2024 as the standard deviation of daily percentage returns ((Close_t / Close_{t-1}) - 1).

The accounts to evaluate are IRA/Trust accounts held by Conservative or Moderate clients: Elena Vasquez (IRA, Conservative) — holds GOOGL (+70); Catherine O'Brien (Trust, Moderate) — holds AAPL (+50), GOOGL (+100), MSFT (-30); Diane Moretti (Trust, Conservative) — holds GOOGL (-50), MSFT (+30); Robert Engström (IRA, Conservative) — no AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL positions.
Sandra & Thomas Park (Joint) and Kenji Watanabe (Corporate) must be excluded because neither has an IRA or Trust account type.
Only positions in tickers with daily return volatility exceeding 2.5% must be flagged as suitability concerns.

rubrics.rubric: Does the Compliance Notes section identify that cancelled trades #85 (Diane Moretti, AMZN, $9,032.00) and #89 (Robert Engström, GOOGL, $14,362.50) have no corresponding clawback entries?
criterion: There are 5 cancelled trades (#27, #28, #58, #85, #89) but only 3 clawback adjustments: adj #4 → trade #27, adj #6 → trade #58, adj #8 → trade #28.
Cancelled trade #85 (Diane Moretti, AMZN BUY, $9,032.00, commission $135.48) has NO corresponding clawback entry in commission_adjustments.
Cancelled trade #89 (Robert Engström, GOOGL BUY, $14,362.50, commission $172.35) has NO corresponding clawback entry in commission_adjustments.
The total un-reversed commissions from trades #85 and #89 amount to $307.83, and this must be explicitly flagged as a compliance discrepancy.

rubrics.rubric: Does the response correctly report that all 12 clients have repeat settled trades, yielding 100% client retention for each of the 3 agents?
criterion: Client retention is the ratio of clients with 2 or more settled trades to total clients per agent.
Each agent serves exactly 4 clients, and all 12 clients have multiple settled trades in Q4 2024, yielding 100% retention: Marcus Chen 4/4, Rebecca Lawson 4/4, David Kowalski 4/4.
The response must show the repeat vs. one-time client counts and the resulting retention ratio for each agent.

rubrics.rubric: Does the fee_audit_q4_2024.xlsx file contain 3 sheets ('SEC Fee Validation', 'TAF Fee Validation', 'Commission Tier Audit') with the specified column structures and all 30 settled sell transactions?
criterion: The fee_audit_q4_2024.xlsx file must contain three separate sheets: 'SEC Fee Validation', 'TAF Fee Validation', and 'Commission Tier Audit'.
'SEC Fee Validation' sheet must include columns: Transaction ID, Client, Agent, Ticker, Sell Amount, Recorded SEC Fee, Calculated SEC Fee, Variance — with all 30 settled sell transactions listed.
'TAF Fee Validation' sheet must include columns: Transaction ID, Client, Agent, Ticker, Shares Sold, Recorded TAF Fee, Calculated TAF Fee, Variance — with all 30 settled sell transactions listed.
'Commission Tier Audit' sheet must include columns: Name, Tier, Internal Rate, Fidelity Online Rate, Fidelity Rep-Assisted Rate, and Industry Classification.

rubrics.rubric: Does the portfolio_risk_analysis_q4_2024.xlsx file contain 3 sheets ('Position Valuation', 'Concentration Risk', 'Account Suitability Flags') with complete client-level analysis?
criterion: The portfolio_risk_analysis_q4_2024.xlsx file must contain three sheets: 'Position Valuation', 'Concentration Risk', and 'Account Suitability Flags'.
'Position Valuation' sheet must show each client's net position per ticker with valuation amounts and price source labels.
'Concentration Risk' sheet must show each position's percentage of total portfolio value with flags for positions exceeding the applicable threshold (40% general, 30% for Conservative clients).
'Account Suitability Flags' sheet must evaluate IRA and Trust accounts held by Conservative or Moderate clients for exposure to tickers with Q4 daily return volatility exceeding 2.5%.
